description.en: Styracosaurus albertensis: whole-organism living environment prop. Nominal1m length, soft tissue, colour, horn sheath, individual spike number and curvature, minor toes are art. CMN344 is limb anchor; Fig1 K-M published reconstruction not scan. Single nasal horn and three paired long radial frill spikes; no long brow horns.
description.zh: Styracosaurus风格化完整活体环境道具；软组织、姿态、颜色与名义尺度含艺术解释，并非精确标本。
